doc.title: Severe bronchospasm on the ventilator
doc.story: A ventilated 45-year-old woman develops severe bronchospasm: airway pressure climbs to the ventilator's limit, the delivered tidal volume falls, the capnogram turns shark-fin and air trapping builds. Give salbutamol and watch ventilation recover: delivered tidal volume and minute volume rise as air trapping eases.

objectives.text: Recognise bronchospasm on the ventilator: high peak pressure, shark-fin capnogram, auto-PEEP

objectives: Watch the delivered tidal volume and minute volume recover as air trapping eases
takeHome: High peak pressure, a shark-fin capnogram and auto-PEEP: think of bronchospasm.
Watch the delivered tidal volume and minute volume recover as air trapping eases.
doc.notes: Showcase case (Stage 9 Task 26): the airway event 'bronchospasm' at severity 1 (it aliases 7b's bronchospasm row); salbutamol's bronchodilation is FU-6's.
